# The samples share one three.c program table (cmake/programs.cmake): what
# they draw, regenerated by tools/programs.mjs.
set(CW_PROGRAMS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/programs/cw_samples.txt)

cw_add_app(hello SOURCES hello/main.c)
# vertex colours as rgb and as rgba attributes (glTF writes four floats): both draw, alpha is not used
cw_add_app(vertex_colors SOURCES vertex_colors/main.c)
# one InstancedMesh with every optional vertex attribute (two uv sets, vertex and instance colours, tangents) and five maps: GL and WebGPU agree
cw_add_app(instanced_attributes SOURCES instanced_attributes/main.c)
# characters: skin shading, glTF material extensions, morph targets on skinned meshes, many instances of one glTF
cw_add_app(character_skin SOURCES character_skin/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/character_skin/assets
  PROGRAMS character_skin/programs/character_skin.txt)
# a coloured glow along silhouettes that fades in with distance (team colours at range, a pulsing shimmer)
cw_add_app(rim_light SOURCES rim_light/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/rim_light/assets)
# fine texture detail at grazing angles (anisotropic filtering, mip chains, sRGB albedo, normal maps): GL and WebGPU draw the same picture
cw_add_app(texture_filtering SOURCES texture_filtering/main.c)
# the game shell's join screen opened during a match: seats added and dropped between rounds
cw_add_app(shell_join SOURCES shell_join/main.c)

# actions, tick/frame snapshots, rebinding, touch controls, record/replay (120 Hz).
cw_add_app(input_demo SOURCES input_demo/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/input_demo/assets)
# motion inputs and the framing camera: a command buffer reading a quarter circle, a rising strike and a dash; a fit for two moving points
cw_add_app(motion_demo SOURCES motion_demo/main.c)

# upstream's determinism scenes + Box3D's large pyramid on the job pool.
# deps/<lib>/shared is upstream's sample support code, compiled as-is.
cw_add_app(physics_determinism SOURCES physics_determinism/main.c
  ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/determinism.c ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/human.c ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/utils.c
  ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/benchmarks.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/box2d_determinism.c)
# Box2D's shared/determinism.c has the same file name and header name as
# Box3D's; compile it through a renamed copy so both live in one app.
configure_file(${DEPS}/box2d/shared/determinism.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/box2d_determinism.c COPYONLY)
set_source_files_properties(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/box2d_determinism.c PROPERTIES
  INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${DEPS}/box2d/shared COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
set_source_files_properties(${DEPS}/box3d/shared/determinism.c ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/human.c
  ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/utils.c ${DEPS}/box3d/shared/benchmarks.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
target_include_directories(physics_determinism PRIVATE ${DEPS}/box3d/shared)

# big open worlds (cartwheel/stream.h): a 16.4 km world in 512 m cells, streamed in
# around a car or a flight; the world (45 MB of zstd cell files) is generated
# at build time by gen-world.mjs
set(_ow ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/gen/open_world)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${_ow})
add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${_ow}/stamp
  COMMAND node ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/open_world/gen-world.mjs ${_ow}
  DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/open_world/gen-world.mjs ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/open_world/assets/main.cwscene
  COMMENT "open_world: generating the world")
add_custom_target(open_world_world DEPENDS ${_ow}/stamp)
cw_add_app(open_world SOURCES open_world/main.c ASSETS ${_ow} PROGRAMS open_world/programs/open_world.txt)
add_dependencies(open_world open_world_world)
set_property(TARGET open_world APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS ${_ow}/stamp)
# audio: an offline-rendered scripted mix (the cross-host hash gate) and
# a sample that plays through the real device path.
cw_add_app(audio_mix SOURCES audio_mix/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/audio_mix/assets)
cw_add_app(audio_play SOURCES audio_play/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/audio_play/assets)

cw_add_app(profile_demo SOURCES profile_demo/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/profile_demo/assets)
# video: an MPEG-1 cutscene (pl_mpeg) drawn on GL or WebGPU, its sound mixed offline

cw_add_app(hot_demo SOURCES hot_demo/main.c)
if(NOT CW_CART)
  # the "edited" build cwhot swaps to in tests/hot.mjs
  add_library(hot_demo_hot2 MODULE hot_demo/main.c)
  set_target_properties(hot_demo_hot2 PROPERTIES PREFIX "" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ON)
  target_include_directories(hot_demo_hot2 PRIVATE ${CW_HOT_INCLUDES})
  target_compile_definitions(hot_demo_hot2 PRIVATE CW_HOT_MODULE=1 SPIN_SPEED=0.02f)
  # hot_demo's program tables, as hot_demo_hot carries them (cwhot registers them)
  get_target_property(_pgen hot_demo CW_PROGRAMS_GEN)
  if(_pgen)
    get_target_property(_plibs hot_demo CW_PROGRAMS_LIBS)
    target_sources(hot_demo_hot2 PRIVATE ${_pgen})
    target_link_libraries(hot_demo_hot2 PRIVATE ${_plibs})
  endif()
endif()

cw_add_app(gi_shadow SOURCES gi_shadow/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gi_shadow/assets PROGRAMS gi_shadow/programs/gi_shadow.txt)
# CSG greyboxing: a level blocked out with box, cylinder and sphere booleans, baked by cwcsg (level.cwcsg);
# a ball lands on the baked mesh through a TRIMESH collision shape; one root without a bake shows the preview.
cw_add_app(csg_greybox SOURCES csg_greybox/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/csg_greybox/assets)
# The showcase: an outdoor valley through a day / night cycle
# (terrain LOD, a forest, a village with 193 lights, shadows, height
# fog, skinned walkers, the modern post stack). The walkers are Khronos
# CesiumMan (CC-BY-4.0), staged with its license as anim_skinned does;
# samples/showcase/CREDITS.txt records every asset. showcase_perf renders
# 1920x1080 with longer segments for tests/showcase-perf.mjs.
set(CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/showcase_assets)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS})
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/showcase/assets/main.cwscene ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS}/main.cwscene COPYONLY)
configure_file(${CW_THREE_DIR}/test/assets/CesiumMan.glb ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS}/CesiumMan.glb COPYONLY)
configure_file(${CW_THREE_DIR}/test/assets/CesiumMan.LICENSE.md ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS}/CesiumMan.LICENSE.md COPYONLY)
# the decal images are fx_decals' generated CC0 art
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fx_decals/assets/decals/scorch.png ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS}/decals/scorch.png COPYONLY)
configure_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fx_decals/assets/decals/cracks.png ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS}/decals/cracks.png COPYONLY)
cw_add_app(showcase SOURCES showcase/main.c showcase/world.c ASSETS ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS})
cw_add_app(showcase_perf SOURCES showcase/main.c showcase/world.c ASSETS ${CW_SHOWCASE_ASSETS})
target_compile_definitions(showcase_perf PRIVATE SC_PERF=1)
# networking: a two-player arena on rollback netcode (cartwheel/net.h).
# net_arena runs both peers in one process over the simulated network (every
# host); net_arena_peer joins a tools/cwrelay.mjs room through the wasmcart
# peer connection (its manifest grants localhost: a test build, never shipped).
cw_add_app(net_arena SOURCES net_arena/main.c ASSETS ${R2D_ASSETS})
cw_add_app(net_arena_peer SOURCES net_arena/main.c ASSETS ${R2D_ASSETS} NET localhost)
target_compile_definitions(net_arena_peer PRIVATE NET_ARENA_JOIN="ws://localhost:47731/arena")
# the cart-side control: the same peer with a score miscounted once (tests/net.mjs)
cw_add_app(net_arena_peer_desync SOURCES net_arena/main.c ASSETS ${R2D_ASSETS} NET localhost)
target_compile_definitions(net_arena_peer_desync PRIVATE NET_ARENA_JOIN="ws://localhost:47731/arena" NET_ARENA_DESYNC=1)
# Trigger nodes ("when X then Y" rules in scene files, cartwheel/triggers.h)
cw_add_app(triggers_demo SOURCES triggers_demo/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/triggers_demo/assets)
# localization and accessibility. One UI in English, the en-XA
# pseudo-locale, Arabic and Japanese from packed catalogs (Noto fonts from
# deps, subset by cwpack); l10n_nav plays a scripted gamepad session in
# Arabic (focus navigation, popup focus restore, rebinding).
cw_add_app(l10n_demo SOURCES l10n_demo/main.c PACK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/l10n_demo/project/roots.txt)
cw_add_app(l10n_nav SOURCES l10n_demo/main.c PACK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/l10n_demo/project/roots.txt)
target_compile_definitions(l10n_nav PRIVATE L10N_NAV=1)

add_subdirectory(plugin_demo)

cw_add_app(fx_pipeline SOURCES fx_pipeline/main.c ASSETS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fx_pipeline/assets)
